digest.component_or_area: external integration test suite and CI workflow
propositions: External integration tests currently run live against only one provider (Anthropic) despite rebar supporting multiple credentialed providers (Anthropic, Bedrock, OpenAI), leaving provider-specific regressions undetected by CI automation.

Provider must be exposed as an explicit matrix dimension in CI workflows rather than an ambient default, with each arm conditionally skipping loudly when its credential is absent, so missing secrets are distinguishable from passing runs.

Provider selection must occur via REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE layered config mechanism (not deprecated bare REBAR_LLM_MODEL) to exercise the documented developer override path and ensure deep-merge semantics leave discovered config intact except for provider/model selection.

Bedrock arm must authenticate via OIDC role assumption on GitHub-hosted runners (not the EC2 instance-role path used in S7), with both REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION and AWS_DEFAULT_REGION set explicitly as job environment to prevent silent NoRegionError failures.

Config overlays that set [llm.model_classes] must also repoint the ambient cfg.model default so all code paths (including those reading cfg.model directly rather than selecting by class) resolve to the declared provider on each arm.
Live test execution against real providers must be verified per arm (collected/executed/skipped counts) rather than inferred from job conclusion to confirm coverage is not vacuous.
